data.body:
Fixes bug B0a21f6fd1b: services/sessions harness_session_id: ids like '///' sanitise to '' and return '' (before the collision digest), and 'a/b' maps to h-ab-<D> which equals harness_session_id('ab-<D>'). Reviewer findings (critic, qwen3.8/deepseek) on SZ-split-sessions; pre-existing, unchanged by the split. Found on SZ-split-sessions.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B0a21f6fd1b --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B0a21f6fd1b --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B0a21f6fd1b: harness_session_id is not injective and returns empty for ids that sanitise to nothing
